user_actions: Ask GDOT (Crash Reporting Unit / GEARS 866-495-4206, or Office of Traffic Safety & Design) for a statewide AASHTOWare Safety export (crash + vehicle + person) and written permission for use in a paid tool
Or ask ARC for a licence on 'Crashes 2020-2024' and for the crash date and time fields
